name: 词汇多样性分析
description: Measures lexical diversity and word choice patterns to identify AI-generated text.
useCase: Detecting AI text through analysis of vocabulary richness and word repetition patterns
mechanism: Calculates multiple lexical diversity metrics including Type-Token Ratio (TTR), Hapax Legomena ratio, and vocabulary growth rate. AI-generated text often exhibits different vocabulary distribution patterns compared to human writing — typically using a narrower range of words with more repetitive phrasing.
source: Dugan et al. (2023) - Real or Fake Text?: Investigating Human Ability to Detect Boundaries Between Human-Written and Machine-Generated Text, AAAI
algorithm: Type-Token Ratio (TTR) + Hapax Legomena + Vocabulary Growth Rate + Yule's K
parameters: Window: 100-500 tokens, Metrics: TTR, MTLD, HD-D, Yule's K
strengths:
• Captures fundamental patterns of word choice
• Language-model agnostic detection
• Works across multiple languages
• Computationally lightweight
limitations:
• Topic-dependent vocabulary variation
• Short texts reduce accuracy
• Technical/specialized text has naturally limited vocabulary
• AI models are improving vocabulary diversity

references.title: Dugan, L. et al. (2023). Real or Fake Text? AAAI.
Uchendu, A. et al. (2020). Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation. EMNLP.
Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. arXiv.
